Rhea (Marketing): Quick request — need a compact visual kit for the inference economics launch. Must-haves: 1) benchmark one-pager (print + web), 2) three email hero variants for segmented nurture, 3) two social card sizes. Comps in 36h, finals in 4 days.

Kai (Design): On it. Which segments for the email lanes? And static only?

Rhea (Marketing): Segments: Platform/SRE, Product PMs, Founders/ICs. Emails static PNG/JPG. Web hero may have subtle motion but not required.

Omar (Creative Ops): We'll deliver a Figma kit + flattened exports. Want localization for APAC/EU?

Rhea (Marketing): Yes — en, ja, de minimal translations. Also include a modular CTA component (Demo / Try API) and a stat overlay for social.

Kai (Design): Draft specs: Email hero 600x240 (mobile-safe 600x200) PNG @2x, Social wide 1200x630 PNG, Square 800x800 SVG, 1-page PDF letter + 1080x1920 PNG for stories. Figma + README.

Anya (Legal): Note: avoid absolute percentage claims unless sourced. Use "up to" or similar. Ping legal for quick copy sweep once comps are ready.

figma-bot: Task created: K-9021 "inference-econ-kit" assignees Kai,Omar. Due: comps 36h, final 4d.

Kai (Design): Cool. I'll post first screenshots in ~12-18h. Annotating alt-text and brand tokens in the file.

Omar (Creative Ops): I'll prep export presets and a small sales CSV so numbers can be swapped easily.

Rhea (Marketing): Thanks team. If font or permissions block anything, flag here.
